content:
Salvador's End of Suffering (2 cost) benefits fully from the appropriate HP Recovery % bonuses, so it would be fair to expect that Xu's Overexalt Enthrall effect would behave in the same way. Unfortunately, as far as I can see, it doesn't benefit from... any of them. I didn't notice this before because outside of Saya teams you never have enough Furnace cap to really notice the difference!

Both example videos are made with my Level 90 Xu (I have issues <:GDoll_serenity:1468257540809822302>)

Lv. 90 Xu CON with 10/10 Soulforge: 351 CON
Base Furnace Accumulation per 1 Spellbound stack removed: 71 (70.2)

In both example videos, I have Gold Serpent's Husk for +20% HP recovery. Saya is also on the team for Propagation Fiesta 20 which should give the Exalt +20% HP recovery as well. Also, in the second video I'd used Song of Saya on Xu that turn for extra Propagation Fiesta stacks and had also directly used a Propagule Embryo if I remember correctly.

Video 1: 10 stacks removed, +710 Furnace
Video 2: 14 stacks removed, +994 Furnace

...So yeah in conclusion that relic and Propagation Fiesta doesn't do anything beneficial to it. <:Nymphaea_frustrated:1459078117485445288>
